column1: # 🔴 THE FAIL-CLOSED MEDIA MARKER (independent review 2026-09-02, P1 #6).
# Every vector below carries the SEALED TRUST ANCHOR and a selector that is
# absent, misspelled or aimed at the wrong target. The grammar refuses all of
# them -- it always did. What it could not do is stop the early runtime
# generator from treating them as an INSTALLED APPLIANCE boot and emitting no
# masks at all, because the generator's media marker recognised only the selector
# words that these lines are missing.
# The marker is now the trust anchor itself, which only signed media can carry,
# so the suite's `has_media_hint` says "this claims to be media" for every one of
# these and then requires the FULL mask set: no default/multi-user/graphical
# fallback, no installer, no root shell, no getty, no sshd.
